title: PACE athlete profile (athlete/profile.json)
description: Frozen contract for the athlete profile — structured long-term state. Human-readable doc: extensions/_artefact_schema.md (## Profile). schema_version 1.0. Created once by the Discovery intake; thereafter the Analyst (pace-analyst) is the sole updater. `sports` is a list of disciplines; `fitness` is keyed by discipline; `current_phase` is programme-level (sport-agnostic). Optional `_comment`/`_comment_*` metadata keys are tolerated for fixture annotation.

sports.description: Declared disciplines: one for a mono-sport athlete, several for a triathlete. Every entry needs a matching fitness.<sport> block.

current_phase.description: Programme-level (sport-agnostic). A phase row in periodization-rules.csv.

fitness.description: Keyed by discipline. Each fitness.<sport> block holds that discipline's markers. A flat marker block (fitness.fitness_marker at this level) is invalid — markers must sit under a discipline.

fitness_marker.description: The discipline's primary marker name, e.g. ftp, threshold_pace.

learned_behaviors.description: Analyst-written behavioural rules. Each item is keyed by id.
